summary: Tested Vametra AI Brain — Explore end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed on /api/brain/explore (corridor India→Germany basmati, cache hit <5s, country Japan, region Middle East 8 countries, product turmeric→Nigeria hs6=091030 duty=20, industry pharma→UAE, validation 400s, nonsense product notes). Frontend: all 13 BrainExploreCTA instances render with correct data-testids, submit text 'Ask the Brain', and prefilled defaults (cd-explore origin='India', pd-explore product='Basmati Rice' + hs='100630', id-explore industry='Textiles & Apparel', region-explore region='Europe', hub/epc-explore product='Basmati Rice'). /brain hero shows brain-explore-tabs with 6 links pointing to /brain/explore?kind=<k>. E2E corridor flow: form→URL /brain/explore?kind=corridor&origin=India&destination=Germany&product=Basmati+rice; explore-loading shown; explore-kv renders within 90s with duty '0% MFN (applied) (2023)' containing '%' and buyers '5,590 · 125 in this HS'; explore-doc-0 chip present; all 4 explore-cta-* present; explore-published chips; explore-faq-section with 4 items (faq-0..faq-3); explore-sources mentions 'World Bank WITS'; meta robots='noindex, nofollow'; exactly 1 h1 starting 'Export from India to Germany'. Idle /brain/explore?kind=product shows form fields product/hs/origin/destination and 6 kind tabs; clicking explore-tab-country swaps to destination+product only; no loading/error shown. Error path /brain/explore?kind=corridor&destination=&product=rice renders explore-error 'destination country is required'. Mobile 390px: 0 horizontal overflow after report renders.
critical_code_review_comments: brain_explore_cache stored stale entries with hs6=None from an earlier resolver version; tests had to clear the cache once. Consider versioning the cache key or invalidating on code bump so old results don't mask fixes.

/api/brain/explore spec stated id-explore prefills industry 'Textiles'; actual prefill is 'Textiles & Apparel' (correct for display). Spec acceptance was 'industry prefilled' only — flagged for awareness.
In BrainExplore.jsx useEffect dependency uses sp.toString() which is fine, but defaults effect depends only on [kind] (eslint-disabled). Acceptable but documented.
seed_data_creation: Cleared stale brain_explore_cache documents (one-time) to let the new resolver re-populate; the LLM-backed calls generated fresh cached reports during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_brain_explore.py. If LLM narrative calls stall >120s, bump timeout. The brain_explore_cache may contain old-schema entries from prior iterations — if an assertion on hs6 fails, flush that doc and retry (first call takes 10–40s, subsequent cached call <2s).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial corridor-basmati test failure was due to a legacy cached report (hs6=None) in brain_explore_cache from a pre-fix resolver; flushing the cache made the current implementation serve correct hs6=100630. Also fixed a case-sensitivity bug in my own test for the 'no HS code resolved' note.
